decisions: Preserve earlier run identities and notebooks.
Use full eligible sequence duration, nominal 10Hz sampling, 16 prefix observations spanning 1.5 seconds between endpoints and a 0.8-second final rollout horizon.
Explore temporal and bilateral information through matched low-capacity models and falsification controls.
All new whole-cohort source-group cross-validation is exploratory.
Temporal control corrected before outcomes to per-window shifts of the identical selected coordinate/validity pairs.
Prospective normal-validation residual shrinkage added to every learned arm; unshrunk comparisons remain primary.
Complete GAVD audit establishes all normal source IDs already in selected scope; no sample-until-significant expansion.

tasks.responsibility: Full-duration 10Hz extraction and independent raw-cache reconstruction
Normal-only nested source models with matched timing control and prospective shrinkage
Independent code, provenance, isolation and replay review
Verified primary literature and results-grounded manuscript generation
Coordination, protocol, notebooks, vector slides, guidance and integration verification

limitations: Source identity is a grouping proxy, not verified patient identity.
Full pose extraction does not establish clinical labels or identity across overlapping people.
Positive forecast utility and secondary annotation ranking do not establish a superior state-of-the-art architecture.
Current-pose learned transition outperforms bilateral history; own-leg incremental gain is uncertain; shrinkage does not improve the primary model.
All new source cross-validation is exploratory after prior GAVD outcome exposure.
Full-GAVD expansion adds no independent normal sources to this dataset.

All 2,818 prepared windows, 94 run hashes, 80 checkpoints, fitted scalers, source folds, aggregation and metrics.
Six notebooks with 30 executed cells; 22 vector slides; numbers and rendered layout.
Official-style PDF, claims, tables, figures, scope and four-page body.
